Dear Aparajita,

Thank you for reaching out and sharing your experience with us. I'm sorry
to hear that you faced technical difficulties with accessing your camera
and audio during the AI interview.

I recommend the following steps to troubleshoot the issue:
- Ensure your browser and device permissions allow access to the camera and
microphone.
- Clear your browser cache or try accessing the interview link in incognito
mode.
- If possible, try using a different device or browser to see if the issue
persists.

Can you help us to book a meeting via here so that we can debug faster?
https://calendar.app.google/9umr3qnDfdEiNb3s7.
